summary.intent: Get the test suite passing, commit a regenerated snapshot, and run clippy and the remaining lint checks before pushing the changes.
summary.outcome: All 1067 tests passed once dependencies were installed. The regenerated snapshot was committed and the lint set (including clippy) was started, but the transcript ends before its results are shown.

repo: The project is Rust (clippy is part of the lint set) and uses a snapshot-based test, so snapshots must be regenerated and committed when output changes.
Tests only pass after dependencies are installed; a fresh environment needs that setup step first.
workflow: Run the full test suite before committing, then run clippy and the other linters before pushing.
Commit regenerated snapshots as a separate step so the snapshot change is easy to review.

friction: Tests initially failed or could not run until dependencies were installed.
The working directory is not a git repository, which may complicate commit and push steps.
open_items: Check the clippy and lint output, since the transcript does not show the results.
Push the changes once the lint set passes.
